articles.headline: From Vogue to GQ, Condé Nast bets big on AI to expand readership
articles.summary: Condé Nast is deploying generative AI tools across Vogue, GQ, and Vanity Fair to streamline multi-lingual content adaptation and personalized digital subscriber experiences.

articles.headline: EXCLUSIVE: Ad agencies gear up for festive season with AI-powered creative pitches
articles.summary: Major media networks and creative shops are preparing for an unprecedented festive ad blitz, integrating proprietary generative models into rapid concept testing.

articles.headline: How brands are navigating the creator economy in 2026
articles.summary: With micro-influencers yielding higher engagement ratios, top consumer brands are rebalancing annual marketing budgets away from traditional endorsements.

articles.headline: Quick commerce ad spends surge as FMCG brands target 10-minute delivery
articles.summary: FMCG conglomerates are allocating up to 25% of digital retail budgets directly to sponsored listings and checkout recommendations on Blinkit, Zepto, and Instamart.

articles.headline: Consumer durables retailers expand omnichannel footprint ahead of Diwali
articles.summary: Electronics retailers are synchronizing online marketplaces with experiential physical stores across Tier-2 cities to capitalize on festive consumer financing offers.

articles.headline: Meta and Google roll out new AI attribution tools for Indian D2C brands
articles.summary: The platforms aim to address third-party cookie deprecation by providing first-party modeled conversion analytics tailored to high-growth Indian commerce founders.

articles.headline: Sports broadcasting rights see intense bidding for upcoming cricket calendar
articles.summary: Broadcasters and streaming networks are submitting multi-year proposals as premium live sports continue to deliver guaranteed concurrent viewership in India.

articles.headline: Luxury brands shift focus to Tier-2 affluent consumers in India
articles.summary: High-end horology, fashion, and automotive maisons report robust demand in non-metro hubs including Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, and Kochi.

articles.headline: Podcast advertising in India crosses key milestone as listenership spikes
articles.summary: Audio series and specialized conversational podcasts in Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu have expanded brand sponsorship deals beyond metro-centric categories.

articles.headline: Independent creative agencies win major mandates against network giants
articles.summary: Agile boutique agencies with senior-level hands-on creative execution are successfully defending regional and national FMCG briefs against traditional agency holding companies.
